page.layout: One block of text at the top, full width; below it a woodcut engraving of a flower basket (not text); a catchword-like word "Viro" at the lower right of the text area. No margin notes. Digitiser watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.p: rùm ut ipse inter legendum observare poteris , pauca ac leviora illa sunt quæ evitari non potuerunt ob preli festina-tionem; Graviora vero , si quæ sint, ex Indice erratorum facilè corriges;

page.notes: Woodcut of a flower basket in a footed vase, between the text and the catchword; not transcribed as text. The word "Viro" at lower right is printed in italic bold and is set apart from the text block; it is recorded as catchword. Water stains and show-through of the page text are present in the upper area. The first line is a fragment at the start of the page and is kept as such.
